title: 第 16 章 这女人才没那么好心
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
走进外门大殿之后的陈默一眼就看到正前方坐着几个人，大长老坐在左侧的位置上脸色阴沉，而中间的位置上坐着一个身穿灰色道袍的老者。

    那老者的面容清瘦眼神却格外锐利，这会儿陈默在心想这位应该就是外门的首座鹤阳真人了。

    而陆云和陆瑶他们兄妹二人正站在大殿中央，只见他们的脸上带着得意的表情。

    旁边还站着几个长老一个个面色不善的看着陈默。

    “陈默你可知罪。”大长老率先开口而且语气中带着质问的意味。

    “弟子不知犯了什么罪还请大长老明示。”陈默淡淡道。

    “你还装糊涂？”

    “出手伤了陆云和陆瑶还抢走了陆瑶的灵石和玉佩，这些事你难道想抵赖不成。”

    当陈默抬起头看着大长老脸上的时候，表情却没有任何变化把自己叫来大殿果然是为了这件事。

    “弟子确实出手伤了他们。”陈默说道。

    听到这句话之后旁边的陆瑶立刻跳了出来，只见她的脸上带着得意的笑容眼中全是幸灾乐祸的神色。

    “大长老您听到了吧他自己都承认了。”陆瑶说道。

    “他残伤同门抢夺灵石还偷学上品法术，按照门规应该废去修为逐出宗门。”

    “请长老们严惩陈默让他知道触犯门规的下场。”

    此刻大长老也点了点头随后转过头看着陈默，眼神中带着几分冷意。

    “陈默你还有什么好说的。”

    “陆瑶说我抢了她的灵石，可事实是她先抢了弟子的灵石。”

    “弟子和周玄这个月的灵石都被她抢走了，而且周玄还被她打伤到现在伤都没有好利索。”

    “你胡说那灵石本来就是我的，你一个练气期的废物能有什么灵石分明是你眼红我的东西所以才动手抢的。”

    可陈默没有理会她的狂吠而是转过头看了一眼站在角落里的周玄。

    只见周玄的脸色还有些苍白，肩膀上的伤也没有完全好。

    “周玄可以替弟子作证。”陈默说道。

    这时陆瑶的脸色变了一下但很快就恢复了正常，那个周玄不过是个小角色说话根本没有人会信。

    “退一万步来说就算真如你所说那灵石是周玄的，那又如何。”陆瑶说道。

    “我是师姐你是师弟，我教训周玄那是他活该还轮不到你来替他出头。”

    “再说了就算我拿了周玄的灵石又怎样，你一个师弟对师姐动手就是以下犯上。”

    当陆瑶说完之后还看了一眼几位长老，她的意思很明显就算她做错了陈默也不该对她动手。

    “况且你偷学了上品法术这件事你总赖不掉吧。”陆瑶继续说道。

    “一个外门弟子怎么可能会有上品法术，分明是从内门偷来的还请长老们明察。”

    听到这句话之后几位长老的脸色都变得凝重起来，偷学上品法术在青云宗可不是小事。

    如果陈默真的从内门偷了功法出来，那就不只是教训一顿那么简单了。

    “陈默，陆瑶说的可是真的？你当真偷学了上品法术。”一位长老开口问道。

    “弟子没有偷学。”陈默说道。

    “没有偷学那你的上品法术是从哪来的。”

    “自然是弟子机缘巧合获得的。”
content_en:
After walking into the outer hall, Chen Mo saw a few people sitting directly in front of him. The great elder was sitting on the left side with a gloomy face, and in the middle seat was an old man wearing a gray robe.

    The old man's face was thin but his eyes were particularly sharp. At this moment, Chen Mo thought to himself that this man should be the leader of the outer sect, Heyang Zhenren.

    Lu Yun and Lu Yao, brother and sister, were standing in the center of the hall, with proud expressions on their faces.

    There were several elders standing next to him, all looking at Chen Mo with unkind expressions.

    "Chen Mo, do you know your guilt?" The great elder spoke first with a questioning tone in his tone.

    "I don't know what crime I have committed, please ask the elder to clarify it." Chen Mo said calmly.

    "Are you still pretending to be confused?"

    "I injured Lu Yun and Lu Yao and took away Lu Yao's spiritual stone and jade pendant. Do you want to deny these things?"

    When Chen Mo raised his head and looked at the great elder's face, his expression did not change at all. It was indeed for this matter that he was called to the hall.

    "The disciple did hurt them." Chen Mo said.

    After hearing these words, Lu Yao next to her jumped out immediately, with a proud smile on her face and a look of gloating in her eyes.

    "You heard it, Great Elder? He admitted it himself." Lu Yao said.

    "He maimed his fellow disciples, snatched spiritual stones, and secretly learned high-grade spells. According to the rules of the sect, he should abandon his cultivation and be expelled from the sect."

    "Please elders punish Chen Mo severely and let him know the consequences of breaking the rules."

    At this moment, the great elder also nodded and then turned to look at Chen Mo, with a bit of coldness in his eyes.

    "Chen Mo, what else do you have to say."

    "Lu Yao said that I took her spiritual stone, but the fact is that she took the disciple's spiritual stone first."

    "She has stolen the spirit stones of both my disciple and Zhou Xuan this month, and Zhou Xuan was injured by her to the point where he is still injured."

    "You're talking nonsense about that spiritual stone that originally belonged to me. What kind of spiritual stone can you, a waste in the Qi training stage, have? It's obvious that you were jealous of my stuff, so you grabbed it."

    But Chen Mo ignored her barking and turned his head to glance at Zhou Xuan who was standing in the corner.

    I saw that Zhou Xuan's face was still a little pale, and the injury on his shoulder was not completely healed.

    "Zhou Xuan can testify for the disciple." Chen Mo said.

    At this time, Lu Yao's expression changed but soon returned to normal. No one would believe what Zhou Xuan said, just a small character.

    "Taking a step back, even if the spirit stone is Zhou Xuan's as you said, so what." Lu Yao said.

    "I am the senior sister and you are the junior brother. If I teach Zhou Xuan a lesson, he deserves it, but it is not your turn to stand up for him."

    "Besides, so what if I take Zhou Xuan's spiritual stone? If a junior brother of yours attacks a senior sister, it's the following crime."

    When Lu Yao finished speaking, she glanced at several elders. She clearly meant that Chen Mo shouldn't do anything to her even if she did something wrong.

    "Besides, you can't ignore the fact that you secretly learned high-grade spells." Lu Yao continued.

    "How could an outer sect disciple have a high-grade spell? It was obviously stolen from the inner sect. Elders please check carefully."

    After hearing these words, the expressions of several elders became solemn. Secretly learning high-grade spells is not a trivial matter in Qingyun Sect.

    If Chen Mo really stole the technique from the inner sect, it would not be as simple as giving him a lesson.

    "Chen Mo, is what Lu Yao said true? You really secretly learned high-grade magic." An elder asked.

    "This disciple did not steal his studies." Chen Mo said.

    "If you didn't learn it secretly, where did your high-quality spells come from?"

    "Of course the disciple obtained it by chance."
title_en: Chapter 16 This woman is not so kind.
